stratagems.name: The Red Thirst
stratagems.target: One BLOOD ANGELS unit from your army that made a charge move this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Descent of Angels
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a BLOOD ANGELS JUMP PACK unit from your army is set up on the battlefield.
stratagems.target: That BLOOD ANGELS JUMP PACK unit.
stratagems.effect: Do not roll for Desperate Breakout for your unit this turn. Until the end of the turn, add 2 to Advance and charge rolls made for your unit.

stratagems.name: Sanguinary Rites
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after a BLOOD ANGELS CHARACTER model from your army is destroyed.
stratagems.target: One BLOOD ANGELS unit from your army within 12" of that CHARACTER.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. In addition, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of models in your unit.

stratagems.name: Artisan of War
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One BLOOD ANGELS CHARACTER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Ballistic Skill and Weapon Skill characteristics of that CHARACTER by 1.
